TRIGGER: Functional regression, security issue, or canary failure
ROLLBACK_ACTION: Redeploy last accepted isolated staging SHA and verify readback
VALIDATION: Health, login, core journeys, exact SHA

ROLLBACK_ACTION: Disable affected provider flag while retaining core services

TRIGGER: Duplicate sends, provider outage, backlog growth
ROLLBACK_ACTION: Pause affected worker and isolate queue; retain dead-letter evidence
DATA_RULE: No message deletion without retention policy
VALIDATION: No new provider action; backlog stable; idempotency intact

ROLLBACK_ACTION: Detach or revoke staging credential under authorization
DATA_RULE: Preserve audit references without secret values
VALIDATION: Provider calls fail closed and core remains usable

TRIGGER: Schema failure or incompatible data behavior
ROLLBACK_ACTION: Use tested down migration when supported; otherwise forward-fix from preserved backup
DATA_RULE: Preserve user and audit data; no hard delete
VALIDATION: Schema checksum, data invariants, app compatibility

ROLLBACK_ACTION: Disable integration and revoke publishing scope; keep approval artifact
VALIDATION: Published state false and no scheduled automatic post

ROLLBACK_ACTION: Disable Stripe feature and invalidate staging test session
DATA_RULE: No live charge and no destructive customer mutation
VALIDATION: Mode proof and core portal continuity

ROLLBACK_ACTION: Pause producer delivery or route to isolated dead-letter/stub
DATA_RULE: Retain events for replay with idempotency
VALIDATION: No BNA code imported; replay test passes
